# 易緯通卦驗

**ID:** KR1a0167
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0164
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V53.8, p884
**Extent:** 2 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 鄭玄 (漢朝) 註

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The fifth of the eight *Yì wěi* 易緯 texts gathered as appendix to the *Yì*-class of the *Sìkù quánshū*; see [KR1a0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0163) for the broader contextualization. Two juàn. The work systematizes the *guàqì* 卦氣 calendrical-divinatory cycle that assigns hexagrams to days/months/seasons (also developed in [KR1a0164](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0164) *Jī lǎn tú*) and elaborates a *yàn* 驗 (verification) procedure for confirming or correcting the divinatory predictions against observed phenomena.

**Abstract**

The *Tōng guà yàn* together with the *Jī lǎn tú* ([KR1a0164](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0164)) constitutes the principal *Yì wěi* documentation of the Hàn-period *guàqì* divinatory tradition. Where the *Jī lǎn tú* lays out the calendrical-cosmographic apparatus, the *Tōng guà yàn* details the verification-procedure by which the apparatus is to be tested against actual phenomena.
